Yatindriyan.g: suparisuddhamanosamācāratāya ariyiddhiyogena abyāvaṭa- appaṭisaṅkhupekkhābhāvato ca manindriyavasena yatindriyaṁ.

yātī.g: so māṇavo yāti paṭhamakkhaṇato paṭṭhāya gacchateva.
samudāyakittana- anavasesadassanaṁ, avayavato pana agāravasiddhi yathā taṁ sāmaññato sikkhāpadasamādānaṁ tabbiseso bhedo.
so māṇavo yāti, paṭhamakkhaṇato paṭṭhāya gacchateva.
“aṅguṭṭhigaṇanā”ti2 aṅguṭṭhagaṇanā vuccati, ayaṁ mūsikagaṇo aṅguṭṭhagaṇanaṁ na gacchati na upeti na pūreti, parikkhayaṁ gacchatīti attho.
so māṇavo yathā nāma valāhakasaṅkhāto abbho uṭṭhito nibbatto vāyuvegāhato1 paṭigacchati, tatheva– Paṭhamaṁ kalalaṁ hoti, kalalā hoti abbudaṁ.

Yatindriyo.g: cakkhādīnaṁ channaṁ indriyānaṁ abhijjhādyappavattito saṁyamena yatindriyo, etena indriyasaṁvarasīlaṁ vuttaṁ.
